authorization: 기존 정책과 모델은 보존하고 기존 실측 자료로 온도오차 절감을 유지하며 장시간 상승·하강 방향 정확도 개선
data: Same208 sessions/25975points/27groups; same5879 nonoverlap10s windows +/-0.2C; late t>=256s
baseline: Frozen original physics and previous HISTGB_RESIDUAL outer-group models, no refit
algorithm: Add gated coupled-loss gradient-boosted trees to frozen HGB level predictor; learn point level and10s differences jointly. No periodic waveform injection, no temperature clipping.
inputs: Previous39 causal features + frozen physical T + frozen HGB T + age/320 + five signed elapsed channel-state times/320 =47. Initial context/activity/predicted power only; no future actual AP/power or IDs.
objective: Equal-session level MSE +2*equal-session deviation from frozen HGB MSE + lambda_all*class/session-balanced10s difference MSE + lambda_late*class/session-balanced late difference MSE. Tree leaf updates solve exact coupled quadratic.
leakage_control: OuterG frozen power/thermal/HGB all excludeG; recalculate every train/test feature with same outerG frozen chain. No fitting on other-group OOF inputs. Fit residual on train labels only.
interpretation: Already-seen development group OOF, not independent confirmation. Report every candidate and failures; no old gate promotion or automatic adoption.
